implementation: 30-second operational freshness threshold centralized in hydragrow-shared.
Authoritative telemetry now carries operational_state, separate observed_at/received_at, explicit runtime_ready, and contradiction marker.
Controller status merges use observation ordering; delayed controller actuator/FSM state cannot replace newer state.
REST device status and fleet summary expose operational_state and no longer encode unknown contact as is_online=false.
Frontend Dashboard, DevicePairing, and FleetStationCard preserve unknown/stale state instead of inferring offline/online.
Cron action commands require contacted + fresh operational state before dispatch; existing P1.3 safety checks remain intact.
Watchdog default staleness threshold uses the shared operational-state threshold; configured override remains supported.
Controller reboot detection invalidates prior actuator/FSM/runtime-readiness observations when a newer health snapshot reports lower uptime.
MQTT subscriptions are centralized and replayed on every successful ConnAck so broker restart/reconnect cannot silently lose operational-state subscriptions.
